items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, I don't think Dominic, some other people told us that, like some people said that Bolden didn't read. Well maybe Bolden didn't.

ctx.x: Roy read music. And so I don't see where they got the idea that Uptown the fellas didn't. Maybe Dominic was a little, we're good friends, but maybe a little precious because Dominic was from downtown, you see.
Well, I don't think Dominic, some other people told us that, like some people said that Bolden didn't read. Well maybe Bolden didn't.
There's a whole lot of them white musicians didn't read either.
